financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants; closing was expected May 11, 2026, and the excerpts do not confirm it closed
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering, after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us, will be approximately $280.5 million
